sources.name: Overture Maps — buildings
sources.used_for: Building footprints inside the Chelsea bounding box.
sources.cannot_tell_us: Building use, occupancy, or who lives there. Footprint only, no owner.

sources.name: Overture Maps — transportation
sources.used_for: Road segments, so candidate tree spots keep a setback off roads.
sources.cannot_tell_us: Road width, sidewalk presence, or utility conflicts underground.

sources.name: MassGIS 2020 Environmental Justice block groups
sources.used_for: Block-group polygons with GEOID for the Inner Core, so each candidate tree gets the equity (minority %, limited-English %, income, EJ criteria) of the block group that contains it.
sources.cannot_tell_us: The layer carries only EJ-flagged block groups, so a site in a non-flagged area has no EJ block group. No per-household data.

sources.name: MassGIS electric utility by town
sources.used_for: Which electric utility serves the demo town.
sources.cannot_tell_us: Rates, per-household usage, or energy burden. Utility name only; geometry omitted.

sources.name: DOE LEAD Tool
sources.used_for: Energy-burden context by census tract (planned; not yet wired into the pipeline).
sources.cannot_tell_us: Individual household bills. Modeled averages only.

sources.name: Existing street trees (city inventories)
sources.used_for: Avoid planting where a public tree already stands (when a city publishes an inventory).
sources.cannot_tell_us: Chelsea has no published street-tree inventory found. Cambridge and Cape Cod do. Treecast can load any city's tree layer to avoid existing trees; for Chelsea this layer is currently empty.

sources.name: MAPC Inner Core subregion
sources.used_for: The official list of 21 Inner Core municipalities Treecast covers.
sources.cannot_tell_us: Nothing about individual parcels; it only defines which towns are in the subregion.

sources.name: MassGIS municipal boundaries
sources.agency: MassGIS (Commonwealth of Massachusetts) via Overture divisions
sources.used_for: Each town's edge, used to clip buildings, roads and candidate sites so neighboring towns meet with no gaps or overlaps.
sources.cannot_tell_us: Sub-municipal lines (wards, neighborhoods) are not in this layer.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap / OpenFreeMap
sources.used_for: The base map (streets, labels) the Treecast data is drawn on top of.
sources.cannot_tell_us: It is a reference base map, not a source of the equity or energy numbers.

note: Savings and scores shown in Treecast are modeled estimates, not measurements. See src/optimizer/coefficients.ts for every coefficient and its source or ASSUMPTION tag.
